thread:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — we’re starting a staged rollout of Adaptive Ensemble for Hosted API (edge-optimized model ensemble + dynamic routing). This is initially an opt-in preview for us internally and a limited regional GA (us-west-2, eu-west-1) next week. Docs: https://go/redwood/adaptive-ensemble-preview :tada:

Alex Ruiz: Nice! Is this a new endpoint or an option on existing generation endpoints?

Maria Chen: It’s exposed as a new model family name (ensemble-adaptive-v1) you can call via the same /v1/generate route. No SDK bump required for basic calls; we’ll add helpers in the next client patch. Example request:```json
{
  "model": "ensemble-adaptive-v1",
  "input": "Summarize the meeting",
  "routing": { "latency_target_ms": 150 }
}```

Sam O'Neill: What about streaming/tool-calling? latency targets + tool hooks?

Maria Chen: Streaming works — ensemble members stream partial tokens and we stitch them. Tool-calling behaves the same as hosted models; if you rely on function call ordering we recommend setting routing.latency_target_ms to a higher value to reduce model-switching.

Jess Patel: Any changes to rate limits or quota tiers for the preview?

Evan Li: Ops note: preview is rate-limited separately. Default cap is 2rps per org for preview keys; request increases via the preview form. We’ll publish per-token cost estimates in the billing doc before GA.

Alex Ruiz: Will there be per-route telemetry in Console for ensembles (latency breakdown by ensemble member)?

Maria Chen: Yes — Console will show per-member latency + cost and an aggregated quality score. Initial retention is 30d for preview. Feedback form link is on the doc.

ops-bot: Canary schedule posted: canary deploy to us-west-2 starting 2026-06-02T02:00Z, progressive ramp to 20% traffic over 2 hours. Alerting: page on error rate >1% for 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy 2169999999: ensemble-runtime v1.0.0 promoted to canary in us-west-2 by @infra-team — logs: https://go/redwood/deploy/2169999999

Maria Chen: Known caveats: 1) Some long-context models in the ensemble may be quantized — expect minor variance in tokenization for rare tokens. 2) Prefix caching interacts with routing; if you rely on exact KV-cache consistency, stick to a pinned model variant for now.

Sam O'Neill: Test plan? where should eng-ml drop regression prompts?

Jess Patel: Drop evaluation sets into the /ai-evals/ensemble-preview bucket and tag with "ensemble-preview-2169". We’ll hook those into the regression job.

Maria Chen: TL;DR: opt-in preview available now for internal teams, limited GA next week in two regions, same API surface, new model family name, separate preview quotas. Please try it, file feedback, and ping me for early quota increases. :rocket:

Alex Ruiz: Trying now — will post results.

Evan Li: If you run into perf regressions, please include trace ID from Console and ping #eng-runtime.

Maria Chen: Thanks team — will post follow-ups about SDK helpers and billing numbers later today.
